exposure: Nulliparous, term, singleton, and vertex-presenting (NTSV) status
cohort: 6,146 patients who had NTSV pregnancies, with 4,184 considered low risk and 1,962 considered high risk.
finding: There was a statistically significant difference in cesarean delivery rates between low-risk and high-risk NTSV patients, suggesting that the NTSV metric alone may not accurately represent low-risk deliveries.
